name: wildwood_scourge_grows_when_another_non_hydra_creature_you_control_gets_a_counter
notes: Printed: 'Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Your Scourge has two +1/+1 counters; you control Ajani's Pridemate ('Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature'). You play Thornwood Falls and gain 1 life: the Pridemate (a Cat Soldier) gets a counter, so the Scourge gets one more (3).
